en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a large historic building complex partly hidden by trees on a hillside. The main structure on the left has multiple stories, steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and a small dome-like corner tower. To the right stands a smaller villa-like building with a tiled roof. Dense woodland forms the background. At the top of the image, a handwritten-style caption in German reads "Schloß Coswig i. Sa."
